= value;\n446\t    for part in path.split('.') {\n447\t        // Handle array indexing like parts[0]\n448\t        if let Some(bracket_pos) = part.find('[') {\n449\t            let key = _ => None,\n470\t    }\n471\t}\n472\t\n473\t/// Parse timestamp from various formats\n474\tpub fn parse_timestamp(value: &Value, path: &str) -> Result<DateTime<Utc>> {\n475\t    let ts_str = The format varies by import type:\n///\n/// - **For `use` statements**: Full module path being imported (e.g., `\"std::collections::HashMap\"`,\n///   `\"crate::module::Item\"`, `\"super::ParentModule\"`)\n/// - **For `extern crate`**: The crate name (e.g., `\"serde\"`, `\"tokio\"`)\n/// - **For `mod`**: The module name (e.g., `\"foo\"`, `\"bar\"`)\n///\n/// **Constraints:**\n/// - Non-empty string (cannot be `\"\"`)\n/// - Contains only valid Rust identifier characters and path separators (`::`)\n/// - Case-sensitive (matches Rust's rules)\n///\n/// **Usage in practice:**\n/// ```rust\n/// use agentscribe::parser::{Import, ImportType};\n///\n/// // Standard library import\n/// let std_import = Import::new(\"std::collections::HashMap\".to_string(), ImportType::Use, 5);\n///\n/// // Crate-relative import\n/// let crate_import = Import::new(\"crate::module::Item\".to_string(), ImportType::Use, 10);\n///\n/// // External crate\n/// let extern_import = Import::new(\"serde\".to_string(), ImportType::ExternCrate, 1);\n/// ```\n///\n/// ## `import_type: ImportType`\n///\n/// The type classification of the import statement. array indexing like parts[0]\n        if let Some(bracket_pos) = part.find('[') {\n            let key = &part[..bracket_pos];\n            let index_str = &part[bracket_pos + 1..part.len() - 1];\n            let index: usize = index_str.parse().ok()?;\n\n            current = current.get(key)?.get(index)?;\n        } else {\n            current = current.get(part)?;\n        }\n    }\n    Some(current.clone())\n}\n\n/// Extract a string field from JSON\npub fn extract_string(value: &Value, path: &str) -> Option<String> {\n    let field = extract_field(value, path)?;\n    match field {\n        Value::String(s) => Some(s),\n        Value::Number(n) => Some(n.to_string()),\n        Value::Bool(b) => Some(b.to_string()),\n        Value::Null => Some(String::new()),\n        _ => None,\n    }\n}\n\n/// Parse timestamp from various formats\npub fn parse_timestamp(value: &Value, path: &str) -> Result<DateTime<Utc>> {\n    let ts_str = extract_string(value, path)\n        .ok_or_else(|| AgentScribeError::Timestamp(format!(\"Field '{}' not found\", path)))?;\n\n    // Try ISO 8601 first\n    if let Ok(dt) = DateTime::parse_from_rfc3339(&ts_str) {\n        return Ok(dt.with_timezone(&Utc));\n    }\n\n    // Try parsing as Unix epoch (seconds)\n    if let Ok(seconds) = ts_str.parse::<i64>() {\n        let ts = if seconds > 1_000_000_000_000 {\n            // Milliseconds\n            DateTime::from_timestamp_millis(seconds)\n        } else {\n            // Seconds\n            DateTime::from_timestamp(seconds, 0)\n        };\n        return ts.ok_or_else(|| AgentScribeError::Timestamp(\"Invalid timestamp\".to_string()));\n    }\n\n    // Try parsing without timezone (assume UTC)\n    if let Ok(dt) = ts_str.parse::<DateTime<Utc>>() {\n        return Ok(dt);\n    }\n\n    Err(AgentScribeError::Timestamp(format!(\n        \"Cannot parse timestamp: {}\",\n        ts_str\n    )))\n}\n\n/// Extract a field from either envelope or payload based on path prefix\n///\n/// **Envelope-first with payload fallback for caret-prefixed paths:**\n/// - If path starts with `^`, try envelope first (remove `^` prefix)\n/// - If envelope is None OR field not found in envelope, fallback to payload\n/// - Otherwise, extract from payload only\n///\n/// **Resolution order for `^field`:**\n/// 1. Try `envelope.field` (if envelope exists)\n/// 2. Fallback to `payload.field` (if envelope missing or field not found)\n/// 3. Return None (if both fail)\n///\n/// **Resolution order for `field` (no caret):**\n/// - Extract from `payload.field` only\n///\n/// Supports dot notation for nested fields (e.g., `^outer.ts` or `user.role`)\n/// and array indexing (e.g., `items[0].name`).\npub fn extract_with_envelope(\n    path: &str,\n    payload: &Value,\n    envelope: Option<&Value>,\n) -> Option<Value> {\n    if has_caret_prefix(path) {\n        // Strip the caret prefix\n        if let Some(envelope_path) = path.strip_prefix('^') {\n            // Try envelope first\n            if let Some(env) = envelope {\n                if let Some(value) = extract_field(env, envelope_path) {\n                    return Some(value); // Found in envelope\n                }\n            }\n            // Fallback to payload (using path without ^)\n            extract_field(payload, envelope_path)\n        } else {\n            // Should not happen due to starts_with check, but handle defensively\n            None\n        }\n    } else {\n        // No caret prefix - extract from payload only\n        extract_field(payload, path)\n    }\n}\n\n/// Extract a string field from either envelope or payload based on path prefix\n///\n/// Wrapper around `extract_with_envelope` that converts the raw `Value` to a string,\n/// following the same coercion rules as `extract_string` (String, Number, Bool, Null).\npub fn extract_string_with_envelope(\n    path: &str,\n    payload: &Value,\n    envelope: Option<&Value>,\n) -> Option<String> {\n    let value = extract_with_envelope(path, payload, envelope)?;\n    match value {\n        Value::String(s) => Some(s),\n        Value::Number(n) => Some(n.to_string()),\n        Value::Bool(b) => Some(b.to_string()),\n        Value::Null => Some(String::new()),\n        Value::Array(arr) => {\n            // Handle content arrays (e.g., Claude Code format with text blocks and tool calls)\n            // Extract text from all text blocks in the array\n            let text_parts: Vec<String> = arr\n                .iter()\n                .filter_map(|item| {\n                    if let Some(obj) = item.as_object() {\n                        // Check for text blocks: {\"type\":\"text\",\"text\":\"...\"}\n                        if obj.get(\"type\").and_then(|t| t.as_str()) == Some(\"text\") {\n                            return obj\n                                .get(\"text\")\n                                .and_then(|t| t.as_str())\n                                .map(|s| s.to_string());\n                        }\n                    }\n                    None\n                })\n                .collect();\n            if text_parts.is_empty() {\n                None\n            } else {\n                Some(text_parts.join(\" \"))\n            }\n        }\n        _ => None,\n    }\n}\n\n/// Parse a timestamp from either envelope or payload based on path prefix\n///\n/// Wrapper around `extract_string_with_envelope` that parses the extracted string\n/// as a timestamp. Supports ISO 8601, Unix epoch (seconds/milliseconds), and\n/// UTC-naive formats.\npub fn parse_timestamp_with_envelope(\n    path: &str,\n    payload: &Value,\n    envelope: Option<&Value>,\n) -> Result<DateTime<Utc>> {\n    let ts_str = extract_string_with_envelope(path, payload, envelope)\n        .ok_or_else(|| AgentScribeError::Timestamp(format!(\"Field '{}' not found\", path)))?;\n\n    // Try ISO 8601 first\n    if let Ok(dt) = DateTime::parse_from_rfc3339(&ts_str) {\n        return Ok(dt.with_timezone(&Utc));\n    }\n\n    // Try parsing as Unix epoch (seconds)\n    if let Ok(seconds) = ts_str.parse::<i64>() {\n        let ts = if seconds > 1_000_000_000_000 {\n            // Milliseconds\n            DateTime::from_timestamp_millis(seconds)\n        } else {\n            // Seconds\n            DateTime::from_timestamp(seconds, 0)\n        };\n        return ts.ok_or_else(|| AgentScribeError::Timestamp(\"Invalid timestamp\".to_string()));\n    }\n\n    // Try parsing without timezone (assume UTC)\n    if let Ok(dt) = ts_str.parse::<DateTime<Utc>>() {\n        return Ok(dt);\n    }\n\n    Err(AgentScribeError::Timestamp(format!(\n        \"Cannot parse timestamp: {}\",\n        ts_str\n    )))\n}\n\n/// Base trait for all format parsers\npub trait FormatParser {\n    /// Parse events from the source\n    fn parse(&self, source_path: &Path, plugin: &Plugin) -> Result<Vec<Event>>;\n\n    /// Parse events from the source, starting from a given byte offset for incremental parsing.\n    ///\n    /// For formats that support incremental parsing (JSONL, append-only logs), this allows\n    /// the parser to skip already-processed content and only parse new data.\n    ///\n    /// # Arguments\n    ///\n    /// * `source_path` - Path to the source file\n    /// * `plugin` - Plugin configuration for this source\n    /// * `start_offset` - Byte offset to start reading from (0 for full parse)\n    ///\n    /// # Returns\n    ///\n    /// - `Ok(events)` - Vector of parsed events\n    /// - `Err(_)` - Parse error (check `is_skippable()` for non-fatal errors)\n    fn parse_incremental(\n        &self,\n        source_path: &Path,\n        plugin: &Plugin,\n        start_offset: u64,\n    ) -> Result<Vec<Event>> {\n        // Default implementation falls back to full parse\n        let _ = start_offset; // Suppress unused warning\n        self.parse(source_path, plugin)\n    }\n\n    /// Detect session boundaries in the source\n    fn detect_sessions(&self, source_path: &Path, plugin: &Plugin) -> Result<Vec<SessionInfo>>;\n}\n\n/// Information about a detected session\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\n#[allow(dead_code)]\npub struct SessionInfo {\n    pub session_id: String,\n    pub start_offset: u64,\n    pub end_offset: u64,\n    pub metadata: Option<Value>,\n    /// Parent session ID (populated for subagent sessions where this session\n    /// is a child of another session)\n    pub parent_session_id: Option<String>,\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::*;\n    use serde_json::json;\n\n    // Tests for Import and ImportType types\n\n    #[test]\n    fn test_import_type_creation() {\n &context.source_file,\n                line_number,\n                \"No role field configured\".to_string(),\n            ));\n        };\n\n        // Apply role mapping\n        let role = if let Some(mapped) = plugin.parser.role_map.get(&role_str) {\n            Role::from_str(mapped).ok_or_else(|| {\n                AgentScribeError::parse_error_with_line(\n                    &context.source_file,\n                    line_number,\n                    format!(\"Invalid role mapping: {}\", mapped),\n                )\n            })?\n        } else {\n            Role::from_str(&role_str).ok_or_else(|| {\n                AgentScribeError::parse_error_with_line(\n                    &context.source_file,\n                    line_number,\n                    format!(\"Invalid role: {}\", role_str),\n                )\n            })?\n        };\n\n        // Parse content (envelope-aware: ^ prefix reads from wrapper, otherwise from payload)\n        let content = if let Some(ref content_field) = plugin.parser.content {\n            extract_string_with_envelope(content_field, payload_json, envelope_json)\n                .unwrap_or_default()\n        } else {\n            return Err(AgentScribeError::parse_error_with_line(\n                &context.source_file,\n                line_number,\n                \"No content field configured\".to_string(),\n            ));\n        };\n\n        // Build base event\n        let mut event = Event::new(\n            ts,\n            context.session_id.clone(),\n            context.source_agent.clone(),\n            role,\n            content,\n        );\n\n        // Extract tool name (envelope-aware: ^ prefix reads from wrapper, otherwise from payload)\n        // Note: This extraction is not restricted to tool_call/tool_result roles to allow\n        // the tool_name field to be used for general envelope field extraction (e.g., testing\n        // that ^model correctly reads from the envelope layer via tool_name: Some(\"^model\"))\n        if let Some(ref tool_field) = plugin.parser.tool_name {\n            if let Some(tool_name) =\n                extract_string_with_envelope(tool_field, payload_json, envelope_json)\n            {\n                event.tool = Some(tool_name);\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Extract tokens (envelope-aware: ^ prefix reads from wrapper, otherwise from payload)\n        let tokens_in = plugin.parser.tokens_in.as_ref().and_then(|f| {\n            extract_string_with_envelope(f, payload_json, envelope_json)\n                .and_then(|s| s.parse::<u32>().ok())\n        });\n        let tokens_out = plugin.parser.tokens_out.as_ref().and_then(|f| {\n            extract_string_with_envelope(f, payload_json, envelope_json)\n                .and_then(|s| s.parse::<u32>().ok())\n        });\n\n        if tokens_in.is_some() || tokens_out.is_some() {\n            event.tokens = Some(TokenCounts {\n                input: tokens_in.unwrap_or(0),\n                output: tokens_out.unwrap_or(0),\n            });\n        }\n\n        // Set project from context\n        event.project = context.project.clone();\n\n        // Set model from context\n        event.model = context.model.clone();\n\n        // Add static fields\n        for (key, value) in &plugin.parser.static_fields {\n            match key.as_str() {\n                \"source_agent\" => {\n                    if let Some(s) = value.as_str() {\n                        // Only override if we don't already have a subagent suffix\n                        // The ParseContext sets source_agent with \"-subagent\" suffix for subagent files,\n                        // and we need to preserve that instead of overwriting with the static value\n                        if !event.source_agent.ends_with(\"-subagent\") {\n                            event.source_agent = s.to_string();\n                        }\n                    }\n                }\n                \"source_version\" => {\n                    if let Some(s) = value.as_str() {\n                        event.source_version = Some(s.to_string());\n                    }\n                }\n                _ => {}\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Handle event expansion for compound events (e.g., Claude Code tool_use blocks)\n        // For now, return single event - expansion can be added per-agent\n        Ok(vec![event])\n    }\n}\n\nimpl super::FormatParser for JsonlParser {\n    fn \"unknown\".to_string()\n                                }\n                            }\n                            Err(_) => \"unknown\".to_string(),\n                        }\n                //\n                // Subagent files are at: .../<parent-session-uuid>/subagents/agent-<id>.jsonl\n                //\n                // ROOT CAUSE FIX (bead bf-1pkfp):\n                // The previous implementation required:\n                // 1. .../<parent-session>/subagents/...\n                        if subagents_idx >= 1 {\n                            let components: Vec<_> = source_path.components().collect();\n\n detection methods, we'd need to parse the whole file\n                // For Phase 1, we only support one-file-per-session for JSONL\n                Ok(vec![])\n            }\n        }\n The primary skip mechanism is **envelope type-based routing** for JSONL formats, which filters unwanted log lines at parse time through declarative plugin configuration.\n\n---\n\n## Skip Mechanisms Identified\n\n### 1. Envelope Type-Based Skip Routing (Primary)\n\n**Location:** `src/plugin.rs:160-194`, `src/parser/jsonl.rs:200-291`\n\n**Purpose:** Filter JSONL lines based on envelope type field for agents like Codex that wrap events in `{type, payload}` structures.\n\n**Configuration:**\n```toml\n[source.envelope]\npayload_field = \"payload\"\ntype_field = \"type\"\ntype_routing = {\n    \"message\" = \"event\",           # Parse into canonical events\n    \"session_start\" = \"meta\",      # Accumulate metadata (TODO)\n    \"heartbeat\" = \"skip\",          # Drop the line\n    \"ping\" = \"skip\",               # Drop the line\n}\n```\n\n**Implementation:**\n```rust\n// src/parser/jsonl.rs:218-291\nlet type_value = extract_string(&raw_json, &envelope_cfg.type_field).unwrap_or_default();\nlet routing = envelope_cfg.get_routing(&type_value);\n\nmatch routing {\n    \"skip\" => {\n        // Line dropped - no event emitted\n        return Ok(Vec::new());\n    }\n    \"meta\" => {\n        // Metadata line - no event emitted\n        // TODO: Future session metadata accumulation\n        return Ok(Vec::new());\n    }\n    \"event\" => {\n        // Extract payload from payload_field and parse\n    }\n}\n```\n\n**Routing Actions:**\n- **\"event\"**: Extract payload from `payload_field`, parse into canonical Event objects\n- **\"meta\"**: Return empty Vec (future: accumulate session-level metadata)\n- **\"skip\"**: Return empty Vec immediately\n\n**Default Behavior:** Unknown types default to \"skip\" with logged warning.\n\n**Code Flow for Skip-Type Lines:**\n1. Plugin defines `[source.envelope]` with `type_field`, `payload_field`, `type_routing`\n2. JSONL line parsed: `{type: \"heartbeat\", timestamp: \"...\", payload: {...}}`\n3. `get_routing(\"heartbeat\")` → looks up in HashMap → returns \"skip\"\n4. `parse_line()` returns `Ok(Vec::new())` - line dropped, no event emitted\n5. No errors, no warnings - line simply filtered out\n\n**Test Coverage:** Comprehensive (20+ tests in jsonl.rs)\n- `test_parse_line_envelope_skip_routing` - skip routing produces zero events\n- `test_skip_type_routing_heartbeat_and_ping_produce_zero_events` - fixture-based validation\n- `test_skip_only_fixture_routing_integration` - end-to-end skip-only fixture parsing\n- `test_unwrap_envelope_skip_type_returns_empty_and_none` - unit tests for skip logic\n\n---\n\n### 2. Include/Exclude Type Filters\n\n**Location:** `src/parser/jsonl.rs:298-318`\n\n**Purpose:** Filter events by type field values after envelope routing.\n\n**Configuration:**\n```toml\n[parser.include_types]\nfield = \"type\"\nvalues = [\"message\", \"tool_call\"]\n\n[parser.exclude_types]\nfield = \"type\"\nvalues = [\"heartbeat\", \"ping\"]\n```\n\n**Implementation:**\n```rust\n// Include filter\nif let Some(ref filter) = plugin.parser.include_types {\n    let type_field = &filter.field;\n    if let Some(type_val) = extract_string_with_envelope(type_field, payload_json, envelope_json) {\n        if !filter.values.contains(&type_val) {\n            return Ok(Vec::new()); // Skip this event\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Exclude filter\nif let Some(ref filter) = plugin.parser.exclude_types {\n    let type_field = &filter.field;\n    if let Some(type_val) = extract_string_with_envelope(type_field, payload_json, envelope_json) {\n        if filter.values.contains(&type_val) {\n            return Ok(Vec::new()); // Skip this event\n        }\n    }\n}\n```\n\n**Envelope-Aware:** Uses `extract_string_with_envelope()` to support `^` prefix for reading from wrapper vs payload.\n\n---\n\n### 3. Error-Based Skipping\n\n**Location:** `src/error.rs`, used in `src/parser/jsonl.rs:575-580`\n\n**Purpose:** Allow graceful handling of non-fatal parse errors.\n\n**Implementation:**\n```rust\n// src/parser/jsonl.rs:575-580\nmatch JsonlParser::parse_line(&line, line_num, &context, plugin) {\n    Ok(mut line_events) => events.append(&mut line_events),\n    Err(e) => {\n        if e.is_skippable() {\n            eprintln!(\"Warning: {}\", e);\n        } else {\n            return Err(e); // Fatal error - abort parsing\n        }\n    }\n}\n```\n\n**Skippable Errors:**\n- Malformed JSON lines\n- Missing required fields (with defaults configured)\n- Invalid timestamps (with fallback)\n- Invalid role values\n\n**Fatal Errors:**\n- File read errors\n- Permission errors\n- Corrupted file headers\n\n---\n\n### 4. Blank Line Skipping\n\n**Location:** All parsers (jsonl.rs:568, markdown.rs, sqlite.rs)\n\n**Purpose:** Skip empty lines in log files.\n\n**Implementation:**\n```rust\n// src/parser/jsonl.rs:568-570\nif line.trim().is_empty() {\n    continue;\n}\n```\n\n**Applied At:** JSONL, Markdown, SQLite, JSON-array parsers.\n\n---\n\n### 5. never an error:\n\n```rust\nmatch routing {\n    \"skip\" => return Ok(Vec::new()),  // Not an error - just filtered\n    \"event\" => { /* parse */ },\n}\n```\n\nThis allows parsing to continue even when lines are malformed or missing expected fields.\n\n### 3. **Warning-Logged Defaults**\n\nUnknown/skipped items log warnings for debugging but don't fail parsing:\n\n```rust\nNone => {\n    warn!(type_value = type_value, \"Unknown envelope type value, routing to 'skip'\");\n    \"skip\"\n}\n```\n\n### 4. **Test Fixture Isolation**\n\nSkip logic tested with dedicated fixtures containing only skip-type lines:\n\n```\n# tests/fixtures/envelope/skip-only.jsonl\n{\"type\":\"heartbeat\",\"timestamp\":\"2026-07-04T10:00:05Z\",\"payload\":{\"status\":\"ok\"}}\n{\"type\":\"heartbeat\",\"timestamp\":\"2026-07-04T10:00:10Z\",\"payload\":{\"status\":\"ok\"}}\n{\"type\":\"ping\",\"timestamp\":\"2026-07-04T10:00:15Z\",\"payload\":{\"seq\":1}}\n{\"type\":\"unlisted_type\",\"timestamp\":\"2026-07-04T10:00:20Z\",\"payload\":{\"data\":\"test\"}}\n```\n\nExpected: 0 events produced, no errors.\n\n---\n\n## Performance Considerations\n\n1. **Envelope routing is O(1)** -
